heading: Fractions of terms of punishment.
text: In calculating fractions of terms of punishment, [2][imprisonment] for life shall be reckoned as equivalent to [2][imprisonment] for twenty years.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
